title: Natural compatible transport on a local representative
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], U an etale T-scheme, Q a finite etale U-scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and e an isomorphism from E restricted to the localized site at U to the lifted Yoneda presheaf of Q. There exists a natural section-compatible transport [def-weil-pbc-finite-local-model-compatible-transport] on Q. Thus transport is defined on arbitrary scheme sources, commutes with precomposition, and identifies the two Q-points associated by e to a common section on an etale source. No diagonal or cocycle laws are asserted here.

from.place: Yoneda comparison, then diagonal and cocycle laws of local representatives

proof.text: Set H = U ×_T U. The pullbacks of Q along both projections represent the same restriction of E by the two restrictions of e and the pullback universal property. Yoneda full faithfulness produces the unique comparison isomorphism identifying their sections. For any scheme W and lifts a,b with equal composite, base change this comparison along (a,b): W → H and apply it to Q-points. Functoriality of pullback proves naturality. On etale W the comparison identifies the common section of E, giving compatibility. The construction on H stays in the small etale site; subsequent scheme base change never evaluates E on arbitrary W.
